purpose: 把来源 Claim 转成可验证的业务语义中间层；Reader 只允许渲染通过该层的事实。
canonical_bytes: UTF-8 JSON, recursively sort object keys by Unicode code point, arrays keep order, separators=(',', ':'), ensure_ascii=false, trailing LF

field_shape.concrete_value: field-specific value supported by one or more raw-coordinate support spans
field_shape.support_span_rule: concrete values require one or more non-empty replayable spans; unknown and not_applicable require an empty span list and never satisfy a Reader-required field

field_contract.subject: entity; concrete value has source span, otherwise the explicit unknown shape
field_contract.predicate: typed relation or action verb; concrete value has source span, otherwise the explicit unknown shape
field_contract.object: entity/value; concrete value has source span, otherwise the explicit unknown shape
field_contract.action: operation verb and actor/target when present; otherwise unknown or not_applicable shape
field_contract.order: ordered step ordinal or explicit not_applicable; never inferred from paragraph order
field_contract.quantity: comparator/value/unit tuple or explicit not_applicable; never inferred
field_contract.conditions: closed list of condition cues and scoped conclusion spans, or explicit not_applicable
field_contract.polarity: positive|negative|conditional|unknown with evidence span only for concrete polarity
field_contract.scope: applicability, version, role, product and boundary qualifiers, or explicit unknown

verification.reader_acceptance_rule: 每个 concrete frame field 的 subject/predicate/object/action/order/quantity/conditions/polarity/scope 必须逐字段与 source frame 对齐；词面覆盖率或 claim lineage 不能单独产生 supported。

render_rule: 业务化连接词可以新增；每个 concrete 主体、关系、客体、动作、顺序、数量、条件、否定和适用范围必须逐项闭合到 support_span；unknown/not_applicable 不得被渲染成具体事实。
acceptance: every supported Claim has exactly one owner source/block/locator
every concrete frame field is replayable against raw-coordinate-map.v1; unknown and not_applicable use the explicit empty-span shape
statement frames and supporting Claim frames are equivalent for protected semantics
semantic-frame-field-closure-v1 is required for Reader; bounded-lexical-v1 and claim-lineage-v1 are diagnostic only
raw-copy and one-to-one rewrite are rejected after frame validation
unknown, conflict or ambiguous frames never enter Reader
